query.name: preview_active_combat_retreat_v1
query.capability: Python production composition gated by game.command.query-battle-control-snapshot-v1-N + game.command.preview-move-army-N-to-N + game.command.move-army-N-to-N
query.implementation: GameplayBridgeService/MCP composition; legality/scope are the embedded BattleControl frame and route proof is the exact native PreviewMoveArmy result

native_legality_call.abi: bool(CCombat* combat RCX, CArmy* selected_army RDX, ErrorSink* errors R8)
native_legality_call.error_sink_policy: always nullptr; reason codes are projected from the same raw frame in native gate order
native_legality_call.read_only_evidence: the exact null-error-sink path has no observed world write
native_legality_call.precondition: the full-generation selected CUnit->CArmy identity and membership in exactly one side of the exact CCombat are already proven

native_rule_state_call.query_call: 0x26165B0(), followed only by a read of uint32(result+0x38) bit 10 when the raw land-status sentinel is -1
native_rule_state_call.read_only_evidence: the exact accessor/read path has no observed world write
native_rule_state_call.purpose: reproduce the landless legality gate; it does not mutate or override the rule

consistency_gates: the outer game snapshot remains paused with the same revision, observed date and played-character identity
selected public CUnitID resolves by full generation; CUnit+0x178 resolves an identity-matching CArmy and CArmy+0x124 returns to the same public CUnitID
CArmy+0x128 resolves an identity-matching CCombat and the selected CArmy occurs in exactly one native stored side ArmyID array
every side ArmyID used for scope projection generation-resolves and links back to the same CombatID
all identity, side, flag, day, phase, landless rule-state, scope and target-preview inputs belong to the same paused revision
a legal zero value and a failed native read are serialized as distinct states

wire.unavailable_reason: optional stable structural reason; absent when available
wire.combat_id: signed int32 full CombatID; -1 is the only missing sentinel

side_flags.skip_pursuit: bool from selected CCombatSide+0xC2; post-winner transition input, not a retreat-legality gate

legality.native_boolean: bool returned by 0x2308250 with a null ErrorSink
legality.retreat_elapsed_baseline_date_raw: signed int32 from the generation-validated BattleResult+0x2C, or the native fallback object; the independent business name is unknown
legality.elapsed_whole_days: signed integer from the exact native day-index subtraction
legality.landless_gate_allows_retreat: bool projected from the exact raw owner/land-state predicate
legality.legal_now: bool conjunction of the four native gates and equal to native_boolean
legality.reason_codes_in_native_order: zero or more of disallowed | too_early | pursuit_or_done | landless
legality.native_reason_keys_in_native_order: corresponding COMBAT_NO_RETREAT_* string keys in native gate order
legality.earliest_day_gate_date_raw: optional calendar lower bound derived from the exact day-index rule; never a future legality guarantee

native_ai_policy.unavailable_reason: optional; required for an ordinary war combat with no exact-proven mission controller assignment

target_preview.route_province_ids: optional positive int32 full ProvinceID[] in native route order

wire.action_ready: bool; false without identity readiness, available legal_now, an available target preview and a fresh candidate token

query.no_target_semantics: legality and scope remain fully observable through query_battle_control_snapshot_v1; the action-preview surface requires one target
query.target_semantics: an available preview proves only that the caller-selected single Province passed the exact native movement validator/path builder; it does not attribute the target to native AI scoring or enumerate all destinations
query.same_origin_policy: reject a target equal to the combat/effective origin as target_does_not_leave_combat_province even when the generic movement preview represents that case with an empty route

CCombat.+0x6B0: int32 phase: 0 maneuver, 1 main, 2 pursuit, 3 done
CCombat.+0x6B8: encounter CProvince*; CProvince+0x10 is full ProvinceID

CCombatSide.+0x10/+0x1C: full CArmyID data/count in native stored order
CCombatSide.+0xC2: uint8 skip_pursuit; not a retreat-legality gate

day_gate.battle_result_resolution: use the low 24-bit index from CCombat+0x708 in module+0x57C0328, then require BattleResult+0x08 to equal the full BattleResultID
day_gate.resolution_fallback: inside native 0x2308250, any BattleResult resolution failure uses module+0x57C0320
day_gate.typed_query_resolution_boundary: the BattleControl query uses module+0x57C0320 only for the legal missing sentinel BattleResultID=-1; any other signed full ID with a generation mismatch fails the stronger same-frame identity gate as state_changed. This is a query consistency boundary and does not claim that native 0x2308250 rejects the same stale non--1 input
day_gate.baseline_raw: signed dword BattleResult+0x2C, conservatively named retreat_elapsed_baseline_date_raw
day_gate.pass_branch: signed jg; legal only when elapsed_whole_days > 14 unless allow_early_retreat is true
day_gate.allow_early_scope: bypasses only the day gate; it does not bypass disallow, phase or landless

landless_gate.owner_chain: selected CArmy+0x124 -> CUnit; CUnit+0x174 -> owner CharacterID; Character+0x1B8 -> opaque land/title-state object
landless_gate.reject_predicate: object != null && int32(object+0x1F8) == -1 && bit 10 of uint32((0x26165B0())+0x38) == 0
landless_gate.wire_boundary: publish only landless_gate_allows_retreat and the native reason; do not expose the object pointer or invent a stronger title-ownership meaning

ordered_legality_gates.predicate_for_failure: the exact raw landless reject predicate is true

exact_layout_and_gates.reason_collection: with errors=nullptr the native function returns at the first failed gate; the typed query projects every failed gate from the same raw frame while preserving native order

scope_projection.query_policy: mirror its owner scan read-only; never call the mutator from the query
algorithm: generation-resolve selected public CUnitID and its full internal CArmyID
locate the selected CArmyID in exactly one side ArmyID array
read the selected owner CharacterID from CUnit+0x174
scan every ArmyID on that side in native stored order and generation-resolve its backing CUnit owner
select full_side only when every owner equals selected owner; otherwise select owner_subset
affected is every same-side public CUnit with selected owner in stored order
unaffected is every same-side public CUnit with a different owner in stored order
scope_projection.full_side: all current Army rows on the selected side belong to the selected owner
scope_projection.owner_subset: only the selected owner's matching armies and combat entries withdraw; other owners on the same side remain in the CombatID
forbidden_interpretations: full_side does not mean war leader
full_side does not depend on the selected Army being first
mixed-owner retreat does not withdraw allied owners

known_mission_scoped_paths.raid: 0x18CE240 -> 0x18CE530; direct legality call at 0x18CE3A5; destination comes from the raid mission controller
known_mission_scoped_paths.barter: 0x18CFC20 -> 0x18D0DA0; direct legality call at 0x18CFD85; destination comes from the barter mission controller
known_mission_scoped_paths.counter_raid: 0x18CB790; legality is reached indirectly through 0x18CBACC -> 0x2248860 -> 0x2308250; destination is the assigned raid target's Province

native_ai_boundary.attribution_rule: publish raid, barter or counter_raid only when the exact mission-controller assignment is proven for the same subject and revision
native_ai_boundary.not_generic_war_retreat: all three known paths continue mission-owned movement; active combat reinterprets that move as retreat, so they do not prove a general war defeat/odds retreat decision
destination_non_evidence: mission-controller targets are not general safe-retreat destinations
SHATTERED_RETREAT_* defines have no closed direct xref to a generic voluntary-retreat scorer
UPDATE_TARGETS_TICK and UPDATE_TARGETS_TICK_LOPSIDED are not proven active-combat retreat cadence

target_preview.token_lifetime: short-lived and invalid after any bound revision or identity changes

submit.transport: existing command-manager clone and submit path
submit.apply_vfunc: 0x26B4710 re-resolves CUnit->CArmy; when the Army still has active CCombat it reaches 0x2308850 at 0x26B48C5 or 0x26B48DC, otherwise it performs normal movement
submit.submission_policy: revalidate expected revision, CombatID, membership, side, scope, all four legality gates and the target-preview token before using the existing player command
submit.ai_validation_wrapper_policy: do not call the AI-only 0x26B49E0 wrapper
submit.direct_mutator_policy: do not call 0x2308850 directly; it is reached only through the existing command apply semantics

action_wire.implementation: Python production composition over the exact battle-control query, PreviewMoveArmy and SubmitMoveArmy; no new native mutator entry

request.expected_combat_id: signed int32 full CombatID; -1 is the only missing sentinel

ack.token_consumed: always true after an order attempt
ack.verification_pending: bool; true after acceptance until a newer observation proves the scoped postcondition
ack.semantic_postcondition: immediate affected-army retreat/target/route observation only; CombatID/winner/phase/full completion remain explicit false until the transition query closes

token_binding: side index/full_side-or-owner_subset and affected/unaffected stored order
planner target and exact native route preview

command_spine.ack_boundary: a move-command ACK, date advance or a single route-field change is not retreat completion evidence

forbidden_native_calls: 0x2308850 ApplyCombatRetreat from any query or as a direct action entry
0x2EB46F0 disallow-retreat effect writer from the query
0x2EB4740 allow-early-retreat effect writer from the query
0x2EB4790 skip-pursuit effect writer from the query

postcondition_matrix.observation_requirement: read a newer paused snapshot after command application; preserve native stored order and full-generation identity throughout verification

required: every affected CUnit enters native retreat state
every affected target and route points to the planner-selected target
the selected side current totals are cleaned
the opposing side is recorded as winner
phase is pursuit or done, or a later same-day join is explicitly observed reopening pursuit to main with winner reset
transition_details: 0x2309070 writes affected route/state before 0x230A010 records the winner
when pursuit is entered the loser initial soft pools are frozen
skip_pursuit may move directly to done
a valid new participant through 0x23040A0 may reopen phase 2 to main phase 1 and reset winner to -1

required: only the selected owner's ArmyIDs and combat entries are removed from the side
every affected CArmy+0x128 CombatID backlink is cleared and its backing CUnit receives native retreat route/state
unaffected owners remain on the same side and bound to the original CombatID
CCombat+0x6E0 is not written merely because this subset withdraws
the synchronous subset pursuit transition is reflected in departed entries or the loss ledger
the remaining battle subsequently evolves from the updated remaining roster
transition_details: 0x23CA360 removes matching-owner rows and armies in reverse scan order while the query preserves public affected/unaffected output in original side order
0x23CD2E0 applies pursuit only to the extracted temporary subset; it does not set the whole CCombat phase to pursuit

reobserve_instead_of_claiming_success: the combat ended before command apply
reinforcement changed side membership or scope
phase advanced to pursuit or done
the target-preview token or route became stale

embedded_projection_live_acceptance.surface: game.command.query-battle-control-snapshot-v1-N expanded frame; the standalone target-scoped query remains pending

full_side_semantic_action_live_acceptanc.surface: Python production composition: preview-active-combat-retreat-v1 -> single-use order-active-combat-retreat-v1 -> existing player SubmitMoveArmy
full_side_semantic_action_live_acceptanc.remaining_observation_gap: superseded by full_side_transition_live_acceptance; this earlier artifact intentionally records the subject-bound query boundary

full_side_transition_live_acceptance.surface: production preview/order plus game.command.query-battle-transition-v1-N addressed by the prior full-generation CombatID
